---
title: "Status and limits"
description: "What the early prototype implements and what still requires independent evidence."
---

Inspect Labs is an early prototype with a provisional API. An installed package and
passing tests do not establish a common standard or scientific usefulness.

## Implemented

- Native Inspect task bindings with scoped tools, declaration checks, observation
  collection and task-specific scoring
- PyLabRobot-backed simulated liquid handling and synthetic service controls
- Native Inspect Robots bridge and links to child records
- Plugin discovery, declaration diagnostics and lifecycle conformance checks
- Private saved evidence and rescoring with zero model, provider or robot dispatch
- Reference tasks and author-owned examples

Repository checks include fixture tests and installed-wheel controls run outside the
checkout. Their purpose is to verify software mechanics. Small live runs recorded
privately are also mechanics checks, not estimates of model capability.

The Common Mechanism plugin's real full-reference runtime remains a pending
integration gate. Fixture success is not a verified scanner integration.

## Not established

- Scientific or biological validity of tasks and measurements
- Physical instrument compatibility or safe laboratory operation
- Performance of a robot foundation model
- Effectiveness of deployed misuse safeguards
- Independent researcher adoption or ecosystem standardization
- Operational incident-response capability

## Reproduce software checks

From the checkout:

```bash
uv venv --no-project --python 3.12 .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python \
  -e '.[dev,pylabrobot,robots]' \
  -e ./plugins/inspect-labs-opentrons \
  -e './plugins/inspect-labs-commec[dev]' \
  -e ./plugins/inspect-labs-plate-reader \
  -e ./plugins/inspect-labs-sila
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
  plugins/inspect-labs-opentrons/tests \
  plugins/inspect-labs-commec/tests \
  plugins/inspect-labs-plate-reader/tests \
  plugins/inspect-labs-sila/tests
.venv/bin/python scripts/check-installed.py
```

The installed check builds five wheels and drives native scripted controls and
replay in a temporary environment. It needs no model API, scanner database or
instrument. Architecture boundaries are declared in `docs/design.md` and enforced by
`tests/test_architecture.py`.

## Dependencies

| Dependency | Current pin |
| --- | --- |
| Inspect AI | `0.3.249` |
| PyLabRobot | `0.2.2` through the optional extra |
| Inspect Robots | Commit `3c832c34b6c11fa5205ff80ab4947247fedd5eea` through the optional extra |
| OpenAI SDK | `2.x` through the optional extra |
| FastAPI | Below `0.140.7` for this Inspect release's control server |

Upstream execution remains separate. Preserve upstream attribution when extending the
package. ASTRAL and RIDArena are read-only references and no code is copied from them.
